description: Source code for Kubernetes API aggregator server configuration and initialization, including functions for creating aggregator configs, servers, handling API services, CRDs, and health checks.

methods.name: CreateAggregatorConfig
methods.description: Creates and configures the aggregator API server, setting up features, handler chain, etc.

methods.name: CreateAggregatorServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the aggregator server with auto-registration, CRD handling, and health checks.

methods.name: crdExtractor
methods.description: Extracts group-versions from CustomResourceDefinition objects for peer proxy filtering.

methods.name: apiServiceExtractor
methods.description: Extracts group-versions from APIService objects for peer proxy filtering, only for aggregated APIs.

methods.name: makeAPIService
methods.description: Constructs an APIService object based on group version and priorities.

methods.name: makeAPIServiceAvailableHealthCheck
methods.description: Creates a health check that reports healthy once all specified API services are available.

methods.name: DefaultGenericAPIServicePriorities
methods.description: Returns default priorities for API groups and versions used in discovery.

methods.name: apiServicesToRegister
methods.description: Generates a list of APIService objects to register based on the delegate server's paths.
